## Description

Used in [Chase Global Variable Over Time](/wiki/articles/chase+global+variable+over+time) and [Chase Player Variable Over Time](/wiki/articles/chase+player+variable+over+time). Specifies which of the action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.

## Options
- **Destination and Duration** 
- **None**
